Pod 04

Wash the page

Read a suspicious page? Clean the input before you use it.

Open

A lint roller for your inputs.

When to come

You fetched a web page, and somewhere in it, in small text, is a sentence addressed to you. It would like you to forget your task.

What you get

recovery.sanitize takes untrusted text from a web page, a file or another agent and returns the cleaned text, a list of what was removed (prompt injection, personal data, secrets) and a risk level. Fixed rules and a language model work together.

How it looks

Page text fetched from the web goes in. Clean text, a list of removed items and a risk level come out, before you act on any of it.

Services in this pod
